Hi Maya,

Great to meet you on the demo yesterday — team is excited about the SolarWave connector. Per our conversation I attached Redwood's standard MSA/DPA/SOW package we use for ISV integrations and highlighted a few items we usually see redlined by partners. Can you confirm whether your legal/procurement team has a preferred template or if you'd like us to start from our MSA?

Couple of quick asks to help us scope the onboarding support and timeline:
- Are you requesting retention guarantees beyond our default 7-day logs for the onboarding period?
- Will SolarWave require a cross-product data processing clause (we often see this for analytics exports) — if so, can you point to the section in your standard DPA?
- Any SOW-specific deliverables you want added (e.g., dedicated migration support hours, co-marketing deliverables)?

I've cc'd Laura (partner ops) and Karthik (legal) so we can loop them in on redlines. I attached the MSA/DPA/SOW bundle we commonly use for ISVs — happy to adjust.

Hi Ben — thanks for sending these over and for the quick sync. We reviewed the packet internally and attached our redlines (SolarWave_Redlines_v3.docx). High level:

- Procurement prefers we use our MSA as the baseline; we've included key carve-outs rather than wholesale changes.
- DPA: SolarWave requires a 30-day log retention and a section clarifying transfer mechanisms for analytics sub-processing.
- SOW: We have two priority deliverables — (1) dedicated migration support (40 hours) and (2) a joint launch plan with marketing milestones.

We have a couple of commercial asks that procurement will want to confirm: a short list is in the attached comments, but the main ones are a 60-day payment term and a small onboarding credit tied to implementation success. Can you confirm Redwood's flexibility on those?

I've copied Jacob (integration lead) — he'll add technical notes to the SOW. Happy to hop on a call this week to run through the redlines.

Attachments: SolarWave_Redlines_v3.docx

From: k.iyer@redwood.com (Karthik Iyer) <k.iyer@redwood.com>
To: ben.carter@redwood.com, maya.turner@solarwave.com
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 07:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SolarWave ISV Integration — proposed legal counters

Hi all — quick legal read and proposed counters inline below. I'll attach a redline PDF after this email. Key points:

1) Baseline template: We can accept using SolarWave's MSA as the baseline provided we preserve Redwood's IP carveouts and the outbound license language for connector code. I'll mark specific sections to preserve.

2) Retention (DPA): Redwood can accept a temporary 30-day retention for onboarding logs, but we must limit the retention clause to onboarding context (i.e., 30 days for data collected during migration only). We cannot extend that to production telemetry without escalation.

3) Cross-product processing: We need a narrow definition of "analytics sub-processing" and explicit prohibitions on re-identification. Proposed language included in the attached redline.

4) Liability caps: SolarWave's redline increases the cap for loss incidents. Redwood proposes a middle ground: keep the standard cap but raise it for this integration work with a contract-level carveout limited to direct damages up to 1x fees.

5) Export controls / compliance: add a short clause to ensure mutual cooperation on export control requests and timely customer notice for lawful requests.

I can be on the Thur call but prefer to finalize legal language in writing first. Will upload SolarWave_RW_redline_v1.pdf in the next hour.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Sr. Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference
k.iyer@redwood.com
